package com.sherifradwan.ancnative.state

import com.sherifradwan.ancnative.model.DemoPatientDating
import com.sherifradwan.ancnative.model.GestationalAgeEngine
import com.sherifradwan.ancnative.model.eddFromScan
import com.sherifradwan.ancnative.model.parseCanonicalIsoDateOrNull
import com.sherifradwan.ancnative.model.parseIsoDateOrNull
import java.time.LocalDate

internal data class IntakeDating(
    val lmpDate: String?,
    val agreedEdd: String,
    val datingMethod: String = "LMP",
    val ultrasoundEdd: String? = null,
    val transferDate: String? = null,
    val embryoAgeDays: Int? = null,
    val note: String = "",
)

internal fun intakeDatingUpdate(
    existing: DemoPatientDating?,
    values: PatientDraftValues,
): IntakeDating? {
    val method = values.datingMethod.trim()
    val isLmp = method.isEmpty() || method.equals("LMP", ignoreCase = true)

    if (existing != null) {
        if (!isLmp) return null
        val lmp = values.lmpDate.trim().takeIf(String::isNotEmpty) ?: return null
        val parsedLmp = parseCanonicalIsoDateOrNull(lmp) ?: return null
        if (existing.lmpDate?.trim() == lmp) return null
        if (!existing.ultrasoundEdd.isNullOrBlank() ||
            existing.transferDate != null ||
            existing.embryoAgeDays != null ||
            (existing.datingMethod != null && !existing.datingMethod.equals("LMP", ignoreCase = true))
        ) return null

        val dating = datingDraftToDating(
            patientId = "",
            values = DatingDraftValues(lmpDate = lmp, datingMethod = "LMP"),
        )
        val dueDate = GestationalAgeEngine.dueDateForMethod(dating, "LMP") ?: return null
        return IntakeDating(
            lmpDate = lmp,
            agreedEdd = dueDate.toString(),
            datingMethod = "LMP",
            note = "Baseline from intake LMP ($lmp)",
        )
    }

    return when {
        isLmp -> {
            val lmp = values.lmpDate.trim().takeIf(String::isNotEmpty) ?: return null
            parseCanonicalIsoDateOrNull(lmp) ?: return null
            val dating = datingDraftToDating(
                patientId = "",
                values = DatingDraftValues(lmpDate = lmp, datingMethod = "LMP"),
            )
            val dueDate = GestationalAgeEngine.dueDateForMethod(dating, "LMP") ?: return null
            IntakeDating(
                lmpDate = lmp,
                agreedEdd = dueDate.toString(),
                datingMethod = "LMP",
                note = "Baseline from intake LMP ($lmp)",
            )
        }
        method.equals("IVF_TRANSFER", ignoreCase = true) || method.equals("IVF", ignoreCase = true) -> {
            val transfer = values.transferDate.trim().takeIf(String::isNotEmpty) ?: return null
            parseCanonicalIsoDateOrNull(transfer) ?: return null
            val embryoAge = values.embryoAgeDays.trim().toIntOrNull() ?: return null
            if (embryoAge !in listOf(3, 5, 6)) return null
            val dating = datingDraftToDating(
                patientId = "",
                values = DatingDraftValues(
                    datingMethod = "IVF_TRANSFER",
                    transferDate = transfer,
                    embryoAgeDays = embryoAge.toString(),
                ),
            )
            val dueDate = GestationalAgeEngine.dueDateForMethod(dating, "IVF_TRANSFER") ?: return null
            IntakeDating(
                lmpDate = null,
                agreedEdd = dueDate.toString(),
                datingMethod = "IVF_TRANSFER",
                ultrasoundEdd = null,
                transferDate = transfer,
                embryoAgeDays = embryoAge,
                note = "Baseline from intake IVF transfer ($transfer, day $embryoAge)",
            )
        }
        method.equals("Ultrasound", ignoreCase = true) || method.equals("US", ignoreCase = true) -> {
            val scanDate = values.scanDate.trim().takeIf(String::isNotEmpty) ?: return null
            val parsedScanDate = parseCanonicalIsoDateOrNull(scanDate) ?: return null
            val weeks = values.scanGaWeeks.trim().toIntOrNull() ?: return null
            val days = values.scanGaDays.trim().toIntOrNull() ?: return null
            val scanEdd = eddFromScan(parsedScanDate, weeks, days) ?: return null
            val dating = datingDraftToDating(
                patientId = "",
                values = DatingDraftValues(
                    datingMethod = "Ultrasound",
                    ultrasoundEdd = scanEdd.toString(),
                ),
            )
            val dueDate = GestationalAgeEngine.dueDateForMethod(dating, "Ultrasound") ?: return null
            IntakeDating(
                lmpDate = null,
                agreedEdd = dueDate.toString(),
                datingMethod = "Ultrasound",
                ultrasoundEdd = dueDate.toString(),
                transferDate = null,
                embryoAgeDays = null,
                note = "Baseline from intake scan ($scanDate, ${weeks}w${days}d)",
            )
        }
        method.equals("Clinical", ignoreCase = true) -> {
            val agreed = values.agreedEdd.trim().takeIf(String::isNotEmpty) ?: return null
            val parsedAgreed = parseCanonicalIsoDateOrNull(agreed) ?: return null
            IntakeDating(
                lmpDate = null,
                agreedEdd = parsedAgreed.toString(),
                datingMethod = "Clinical",
                ultrasoundEdd = null,
                transferDate = null,
                embryoAgeDays = null,
                note = "Baseline from intake due date ($parsedAgreed)",
            )
        }
        else -> null
    }
}

internal data class IntakeDatingPreview(val dueDate: String, val gestationalAge: String?)

internal fun intakeDatingPreview(
    values: PatientDraftValues,
    asOf: LocalDate = LocalDate.now(),
): IntakeDatingPreview? {
    val update = intakeDatingUpdate(null, values) ?: return null
    val parsedDue = parseIsoDateOrNull(update.agreedEdd) ?: return null
    val ga = GestationalAgeEngine.calculateForEdd(parsedDue, asOf)?.formatted
    return IntakeDatingPreview(dueDate = update.agreedEdd, gestationalAge = ga)
}

internal fun profileSavedNotice(datingAttempted: Boolean, datingSaved: Boolean): SavedNotice =
    if (datingAttempted && !datingSaved) SavedNotice.PATIENT_DATING_NOT_UPDATED else SavedNotice.PATIENT

data class DraftSlot(
    val patientId: String,
    val kind: DraftScreenKind,
)

fun activeDraftSlot(state: AncState): DraftSlot? {
    val visitDraft = state.draft
    if (visitDraft != null) {
        return DraftSlot(visitDraft.patientId, DraftScreenKind.VISIT)
    }
    val patientDraft = state.patientDraft
    if (patientDraft != null) {
        val patientId = if (patientDraft.baseRevision == null) NEW_PATIENT_DRAFT_KEY else patientDraft.patientId
        return DraftSlot(patientId, DraftScreenKind.PATIENT_PROFILE)
    }
    val historiesDraft = state.historiesDraft
    if (historiesDraft != null) {
        return DraftSlot(historiesDraft.patientId, DraftScreenKind.HISTORIES)
    }
    val pregnancyDraft = state.pregnancyDraft
    if (pregnancyDraft != null) {
        return DraftSlot(pregnancyDraft.patientId, DraftScreenKind.PREVIOUS_PREGNANCY)
    }
    val statusDraft = state.statusDraft
    if (statusDraft != null) {
        return DraftSlot(statusDraft.patientId, DraftScreenKind.PATIENT_STATUS)
    }
    val datingDraft = state.datingDraft
    if (datingDraft != null) {
        return DraftSlot(datingDraft.patientId, DraftScreenKind.DATING)
    }
    val ultrasoundDraft = state.ultrasoundDraft
    if (ultrasoundDraft != null) {
        return DraftSlot(ultrasoundDraft.patientId, DraftScreenKind.ULTRASOUND)
    }
    val labDraft = state.labDraft
    if (labDraft != null) {
        return DraftSlot(labDraft.patientId, DraftScreenKind.LAB)
    }
    val medicationDraft = state.medicationDraft
    if (medicationDraft != null) {
        return DraftSlot(medicationDraft.patientId, DraftScreenKind.MEDICATION)
    }
    return null
}

fun draftRecordFor(state: AncState, nowMillis: Long): DraftRecord? {
    val baseRevision = activeEditorBaseRevision(state)

private fun isSlotDirty(state: AncState, slot: DraftSlot): Boolean {
    return when (slot.kind) {
        DraftScreenKind.VISIT -> state.draft?.let { it.patientId == slot.patientId && it.isDirty } == true
        DraftScreenKind.PATIENT_PROFILE -> state.patientDraft?.let {
            val patientId = if (it.baseRevision == null) NEW_PATIENT_DRAFT_KEY else it.patientId
            patientId == slot.patientId && it.isDirty
        } == true
        DraftScreenKind.HISTORIES -> state.historiesDraft?.let { it.patientId == slot.patientId && it.isDirty } == true
        DraftScreenKind.PREVIOUS_PREGNANCY -> state.pregnancyDraft?.let { it.patientId == slot.patientId && it.isDirty } == true
        DraftScreenKind.PATIENT_STATUS -> state.statusDraft?.let { it.patientId == slot.patientId && it.isDirty } == true
        DraftScreenKind.DATING -> state.datingDraft?.let { it.patientId == slot.patientId && it.isDirty } == true
        DraftScreenKind.ULTRASOUND -> state.ultrasoundDraft?.let { it.patientId == slot.patientId && it.isDirty } == true
        DraftScreenKind.LAB -> state.labDraft?.let { it.patientId == slot.patientId && it.isDirty } == true
        DraftScreenKind.MEDICATION -> state.medicationDraft?.let { it.patientId == slot.patientId && it.isDirty } == true
    }
}

fun closedDraftSlot(before: AncState, after: AncState): DraftSlot? {
    if (before.vaultState !is VaultState.Unlocked || after.vaultState !is VaultState.Unlocked) {
        return null
    }
    val beforeSlot = activeDraftSlot(before) ?: return null
    if (!isSlotDirty(before, beforeSlot)) {
        return null
    }
    val afterSlot = activeDraftSlot(after)
    if (beforeSlot != afterSlot) {
        return beforeSlot
    }
    if (!isSlotDirty(after, beforeSlot)) {
        return beforeSlot
    }
    return null
}

**Round 4g review: no Hard Blockers, 2 Should-fix, 4 Nits.** I only read the files; I ran no tests and no `git diff` (no shell here). Anything that depends on the old code is marked unverified.

**Should-fix**
1. **Quote:** `if (embryoAge !in listOf(3, 5, 6)) return null` (`IntakeDatingRule.kt:71`).
   - This is a second copy of the embryo-day rule, which already lives in `ClinicalVocabulary.embryoAges` (`ClinicalModels.kt:174`).
   - `dueDateForMethod` already returns null for bad days (`GestationalAgeEngine.kt:37`), so the line can go.
   - If it stays, use `ClinicalVocabulary.embryoAges`. This breaks the reuse rule and risks drifting if the list changes.
2. **Quote:** `assertEquals("25w 6d", p.gestationalAge)` (`IntakeDatingRuleTest.kt:172`).
   - The spec oracle said `"26w2d"`. The test changes the expected value and explains it in a comment.
   - My count agrees with the test: 2026-02-01 to 2026-08-01 is 181 days, which is 25w 6d, so the spec number looks wrong.
   - The orchestrator should confirm this and fix the spec, not silently accept it.

**Nits**
- **Draft save only for new patients.** `DraftMapping.kt:99-111` adds the seven keys only when `isNew`. The spec says they are saved with the patient draft. Existing-patient values are always blank, so this is safe, and restore uses `?: v.x`, so old drafts can't crash.
- **Round-trip through `datingDraftToDating`.** The Ultrasound branch builds a `DemoPatientDating` just to read back the date it already has (`:97-104`). The spec asks for this, so it is fine.
- **No upper bound on scan or transfer dates.** A future scan date, or 42w0d, is accepted. That follows the spec (`gaWeeks` 0..42), so it is not a bug, but it is worth a design-round note.
- **Missing tests.** There is no test for the aliases `"IVF"` and `"US"`, for an existing patient with a blank-method dating row, or for `intakeDatingPreview` with a scan or IVF input at a fixed `asOf`.

**Checks against your list**
- **(1) LMP-only intake:** the code is equivalent to the old rule. It still gives LMP + 280, the note "Baseline from intake LMP (…)", method "LMP" and canonical-date validation. The new `ultrasoundEdd`, `transferDate` and `embryoAgeDays` stay null. The preview now goes through `intakeDatingUpdate(null, …)` and `calculateForEdd`. I could not diff against the old `PatientEditor` or view-model code, so whether the old preview accepted non-canonical dates is unverified.
- **(2) Existing patient:** the guards are the old ones. Any non-LMP method, an existing scan EDD, transfer, embryo day or non-LMP method, and an unchanged LMP all return null (`:27-37`). The old cases are kept. No dating row is created with the patient, so new-patient IVF, scan and Clinical saves are not blocked by the `existing != null` branch.
- **(3) Second copy of date logic:** none beyond Should-fix 1. LMP, IVF and Ultrasound dates come from `dueDateForMethod`. `eddFromScan` is defined once (`IsoDates.kt:9`). Clinical only echoes the typed canonical date, as the spec says.
